raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Program — Home, Light Activity"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Postpartum return to light activity and progressive strength with core caution"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Intro: Mobility and light bodyweight"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 per side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          wall_push_up 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Stability and breathing"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_side_leg_lift 3x12 per side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds per side
      DAY Friday training 40m "Light cardio and gentle core prep"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 per side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          australian_pull_apart 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          breathing_focus 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Progressive load and breathing"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 per side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          wall_push_up 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility and core light"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_bridge_with_activation 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds per side
      DAY Friday training 40m "Low impact cardio"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 per side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_plank_hold 3x15 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          breathing_focus 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation building"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_calf_raise 2x20
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Stability focus"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 per leg rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds per side
      DAY Friday training 45m "Low impact cardio + core prep"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          arnold_press 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          planks_reduced_angle 3x20 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          breathing_focus 2 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive overload, kept safe"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_cirstretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Mobility and endurance"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 per side rpe 4.5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          pulldown_assisted 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Cardio + light core"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking_lunge 3x10 per leg rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x15 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength foundation"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_calf_raise 2x20
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Core and posture"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_bridge 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds per side
      DAY Friday training 50m "Light cardio + strength finisher"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lunge 3x10 per leg rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          planks_with_knee_tuck 3x14 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          breathing_focus 2 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5.5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5.5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 5.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_circ stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Stability and endurance"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 per leg rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Cardio integration"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          arnold_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          breathing_focus 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Return to regular strength pattern"
        warmup:
          walking 7 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_calf_raise 2x20
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Breathing and posture mastery"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x12 per leg rpe 5.5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 5.5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5.5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds per side
      DAY Friday training 50m "Light cardio finish"
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          planks_with_row 3x12 per side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          breathing_focus 2 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: e.g., `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, inverted_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, hangboard, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing, scapular_retraction, external_rotation, internal_rotation, prone_T, prone_Y, prone_W, pelvic_tilt, diaphragmatic_breathing

CARDIO MODALITIES:
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking
